notes: DID NOT QUALIFY (excluded): Italy (lost playoff to Bosnia on penalties, Mar 2026) and Denmark (lost playoff to Czechia on penalties) - both flagged as doubtful by the brief and confirmed out. Czechia and Bosnia qualified instead; Norway qualified for first WC since 1998 (included, strong - Haaland). Coverage depth is highest for the top ~12 contenders (Spain, France, England, Brazil, Argentina, Portugal, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium + hosts USA/Mexico, plus Croatia). Some predicted XIs (especially full back-fours and squad-rotation No.9s) are best-estimate from late-May/early-June predicted-lineup pieces, not officially confirmed XIs - tag as Medium confidence; nailed_starters and set-piece takers are higher confidence. KEY UNCERTAINTIES to re-check before MD1: (1) Yamal's actual minutes in Spain's Jun 15 opener (hamstring); (2) Germany penalty duty (Kimmich took the last competitive pen Oct 2025, but Havertz widely expected) - affects which to own; (3) Lukaku's fitness/start for Belgium (barely played all season); (4) Brazil's central striker (Cunha vs Endrick vs Neymar - unsettled, avoid); (5) Croatia No.9 (Budimir/Kramaric/Musa rotation); (6) Morocco's CF after En-Nesyri omission under new coach Ouahbi; (7) Netherlands - Depay is pen taker but may not start (Malen/Gakpo could be the front line). Several CL-final players (Marquinhos, Gabriel, Kimmich, Havertz, Wirtz - via May 30 final) carry minor early-sharpness/knock risk. STANDOUT FANTASY VALUE picks noted in team 'notes': Oyarzabal (Spain CF+pens, top MD1 captain), Bruno Fernandes (Portugal, pens+FKs+corners, mid price), Luis Diaz (Colombia, 26G/23A form), Hakimi & Ecuador's defenders (Pacho/Hincapie/Caicedo/Estupinan) as cheap clean-sheet sources, Raum & Kimmich (Germany cheap defenders), Cucurella (Spain $5.1m), Coufal (Czechia $3.6m), Heggem (Norway), Berhalter (USA $4.7m corners). Haaland the safe-floor premium captain; Yamal the highest-ceiling asset with MD1 minutes risk. Did not deep-cover weaker qualifiers (South Africa, Cape Verde, Saudi Arabia, Paraguay, Australia, Turkiye, Algeria, Jordan, Curacao, Ivory Coast, Haiti, Scotland, Panama, Ghana, Egypt, Iran, NZ, Qatar, Uzbekistan, DR Congo, Iraq, Sweden, Tunisia, Bosnia, Czechia, Canada) beyond fantasy-relevant set-piece/value mentions - they are not title/deep-run contenders per the brief.
